author: Bobby Grayson
description: The reader's count/values are observed on the BEAM by :erlang.trace(reader, true, [:receive]); Reader.run(n) state is not observable from outside (no get_state on a raw process). Lean prints the state count and a mailbox observation; both must agree with the BEAM trace.
title: Timer nondeterminism handled in the generator, not the comparison: an expire phase fires the live timer (always the last pending one) in Lean and sleeps 300ms on the BEAM; a second BEAM expiry in that window is unobservable (nil stays nil); stale timers are fired Lean-only (no BEAM counterpart, the BEAM cancelled them) and must be no-ops; a non-expire phase that stalled >100ms triggers a retry of the BEAM side (0 retries seen in 200 runs).
